LOOK_AT.say: Nine funerals' worth of linen money, out of the collection plate. Small coin, and one button somebody gave in good faith.
repeat: It is owed to Mr. Sheng. It is in my pocket. I am keeping those two facts in that order.
The Reverend counted it out with his eyes shut, as though the plate might feel it.
Nothing. It is somebody else's money and it is behaving accordingly.
